details: In version 1.0.3 the index.js differs from the already listed 1.0.2 in one line: the top-level `process.env.PATH = '.';` became `process.env.PATH = '..';`. On `require`, the importing process's PATH is replaced with the parent directory, so every command the host process later runs by bare name resolves from there (the module's own `listAssets` does too when called with `useProcessPath: true`).

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
